chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bahr, from Hariz, who said:
I said to Abī 'Abd Allāh عليه السلام: “May the person in janabah apply oil and then perform ghusl?” He said: “No.”

key_terms.اَلْجُنُبُ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.لَا: a clear negation indicating prohibition or non-permissibility in this context
key_terms.يَدَّهِنُ: applies oil or ointment to the body

ai.seo_question: Can a person in janabah apply oil before performing ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the state of janabah and what may be done before ghusl. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام rejects the act of applying oil before performing the ritual bath, indicating a restriction related to ritual purity.
